en.summary: This one-page certificate states under Supreme Court Rule 33.1(h) that the petition contains 5,512 words, excluding exempt portions. It is a filing-compliance document, not evidence about the merits.
en.plainEnglish: This is the petition's word-count receipt. It tells the Clerk that the filing fits the Court's length rules; it does not support or weaken the legal argument.
legalReading: The declarant certifies 5,512 counted words and invokes the exclusions in Supreme Court Rule 33.1(d).
The certificate is executed under penalty of perjury and notarized.
caseConnections: It accompanies the August 11, 2026 certiorari petition in No. 26-194 and addresses formal filing compliance only.
whyItMatters: It helps establish that the petition package included the required word-count certification.
verificationTasks: Use the official docket to confirm whether the Clerk later identifies any filing defect or requests a corrected submission.
riskFlags: The certificate contains no judicial finding, response position, or merits analysis.

findings.text: The certificate reports 5,512 words under Supreme Court Rule 33.1(h).
The document addresses filing compliance rather than the merits.

zh.summary: 这份一页证明依据《最高法院规则》33.1(h)，声明调卷令申请共有 5,512 个计入字数的单词，不包括规则允许排除的部分。它属于提交合规文件，不是案件实体证据。
zh.plainEnglish: 这相当于申请书的“字数收据”：它告诉书记官文件符合篇幅规则，不会证明法律论点更强或更弱。
legalReading: 声明人证明计入字数为 5,512，并适用《最高法院规则》33.1(d) 的排除部分。
证明以伪证罪责任声明并经公证。
caseConnections: 它随第 26-194 号案 2026 年 8 月 11 日调卷令申请提交，只处理形式合规。
whyItMatters: 它证明申请文件包包含最高法院要求的字数合规证明。
verificationTasks: 继续查看官方案卷，确认书记官以后是否指出提交缺陷或要求更正。
riskFlags: 本证明没有法院认定、被申请人立场或实体法律分析。

findings.text: 证明依据《最高法院规则》33.1(h) 申报 5,512 个单词。
文件处理的是提交合规，而不是案件实体。
